prompt:
Use case: precise identity-preserving facial-expression edit. Edit this exact Aria portrait, output ONE square icon. Keep her blonde elf identity, green hood, feather, hair masses, pointed ears, framing, dark teal background, flat simple rendering and existing youthful-adult age. The user likes the direction but requests TWO MORE clearly visible steps toward soft feminine tenderness and supple rounded cheeks. This must be a noticeable facial-shape/expression change, not an almost identical redraw. 
Change these few features deliberately:
1. Round and soften the lower face significantly: softly full cheeks (gentle mochi-like suppleness), smooth continuous jaw curve and a SHORT rounded chin, no pointed triangular chin. Do not widen the entire head or enlarge the forehead; keep a young adult woman's proportions, not a child's.
2. Make the eyes tender and softly relaxed: lower the outer corners subtly, soften the upper eyelid angle and the eyebrows, reduce sharp cat-eye points. Keep green irises clearly readable and current eye size, with ONE modest highlight per eye. A gentle slightly dreamy gaze and a hint of vulnerable softness, while still friendly and happy.
3. Replace the wide triangular open mouth with a MUCH SMALLER delicate warm smile, lips only slightly parted. Mouth width about half the current width, softly curved, positioned naturally. She is quietly smiling at someone she trusts, not speaking loudly.
4. Reduce the angular nose to a very short subtle curved nose-tip mark. Add a SMALL broad peach-pink blush shape to the cheeks, with no blush strokes or texture.
5. Reduce hard jaw/neck shadow contrast and hard corners of skin shadows, keeping at most one simple skin shadow. 
The intended feeling is feminine, tender, softly plush cheeks, airy gentleness, slight delicacy — not sexy, not sad, not meek, not baby/chibi. Maintain the young adult age of her original story depiction. All other design details must remain unchanged.
CRITICAL retain 64px icon legibility and the APPROVED SIMPLICITY: bold clean contour, broad flat hair color shapes, very few interior lines, at most two tones per surface, no hair strands, no painterly detail, no complex eyes, no glitter, no ornate embroidery, no detailed gradients. No extra accessories, labels, text, watermark, border, hands or other characters. Please make the softer rounder jaw, gentler eyes and half-width smile visibly different from the input even when downscaled to 64px.
